basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace blueprint and pilot plan, testing contractor and distributor assumptions before the pilot decision.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Does the blueprint justify launching the pilot in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first marketplace version to contractors in one region and measure repeat orders and distributor retention.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the pilot results support extending the marketplace beyond one region?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions about contractors, distributors and the portal must hold for the marketplace to work?
activities: Review the B2B ordering portal and its large-account usage
Frame testable hypotheses for each blueprint component
Agree selection criteria for the pilot region with sponsors

workstreams.name: Contractor demand evidence
workstreams.answers: What do small and mid-size contractors need from an online marketplace, and will they use it?
activities: Interview small and mid-size contractors in both markets
Analyze current ordering behavior from the B2B portal data
Test the wireframe prototype with contractors

workstreams.name: Distributor channel impact
workstreams.answers: How can direct sales to contractors be added without losing regional distributors?
activities: Interview regional distributors on contracts and channels
Map overlap between contractor demand and distributor sales
Draft safeguards that protect distributor relationships

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What blueprint and pilot plan does the evidence support?
activities: Consolidate findings into the marketplace blueprint
Detail the pilot scope, KPIs and launch plan
Prepare the go/no-go pack for the steering group

workstreams.name: Pilot KPIs and enablement
workstreams.answers: Which KPIs and internal roles does the pilot need to measure repeat orders and distributor retention?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO and Head of Sales
Align distributors council on how the pilot is measured
Identify internal roles needed to run the pilot

workstreams.name: Contractor target group
workstreams.answers: Which contractors in the pilot region should be invited first?
activities: Segment contractors in the pilot region by size and trade
Interview contractors on ordering needs and decision-makers

workstreams.name: Marketplace build and run
workstreams.answers: Do contractors in the pilot region place first repeat orders on the marketplace?
activities: Build the first marketplace version for pilot users
Launch to the target group and track orders weekly
Monitor distributor reactions during the pilot

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: What would it take, and return, to extend the marketplace beyond the pilot region?
activities: Compare pilot results with the agreed KPIs
Build the business case from pilot economics
Draft the scale-up roadmap and next steps

deliverables.name: Hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component
Contractor needs and ordering behavior evidence
Pilot KPIs agreed with the steering group
Key internal roles for the pilot identified
First contractor target group in the pilot region
First marketplace version launched to pilot users
Pilot results on repeat orders and distributor contracts

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, roles and ways of working
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the scope and governance of the engagement?
agenda: Present the governing question, phases and workstreams
Align on stakeholder roles and access to distributors
Confirm the steering calendar and decision rights

events.label: Check-in: first evidence
events.decision: Should the blueprint proceed on the current hypotheses?
agenda: Present early contractor and distributor findings
Discuss implications for the marketplace blueprint
Confirm the focus of the remaining design work

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide whether the pilot goes ahead
events.decision: Does the blueprint justify launching the pilot in one region?
agenda: Present the blueprint, wireframe prototype and pilot plan
Review distributor safeguards against the success criteria
Decide whether to launch the pilot

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot launch
events.purpose: Review launch, KPIs and early orders
events.decision: Do the pilot KPIs and first results warrant continuing as planned?
agenda: Present pilot KPIs, target group and the launched first version
Review early orders and distributor reactions
Discuss any adjustments for the remaining pilot weeks

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Decide the next step after the pilot
events.decision: Do the pilot results support extending the marketplace beyond one region?
agenda: Present pilot results on repeat orders and distributor contracts
Review the business case and scale-up roadmap
Decide on the next step for the marketplace

architect_notes: The 20-week total is stated; the 6-week Design and 14-week Pilot split is my estimate from the archetype ranges and needs partner confirmation.
Rollout after the pilot is not in these phases because the marketplace is new; the business case and roadmap only prepare the scale-up decision.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, Construction Products Regulation introduces digital product passports. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Pilot has one steering workshop instead of the archetype's two, following the rule for a 14-week phase.
